content:
Emma: quick sync - we need to finalize rerank score encoding + routing sensitivity before the quota/dashboard rollout tomorrow. console buckets spiked in yesterday's canary. anyone seen this?
Raj: saw it. runtime returns float32, collector packs to int16 to save bandwidth. packing shifts bucket boundaries.
Miguel: packing was intentional for throughput. didn't expect it to break SLA buckets.
Sara: product: console requires stable buckets for SLA alerts. quantization causes noisy alerts. can we normalize in console short-term?
Kevin: quota math uses score_units = ceil(score * weight). quantization makes throttle decisions oscillate.
Emma: options: (A) publish decoder + stable bucket mapping and keep int16, (B) emit float32 end-to-end, (C) emit hist summaries. tradeoffs?
Raj: (A) low infra work but brittle; (B) clean semantics, ~12% bandwidth increase; (C) good dashboards but loses candidate-level data.
Miguel: we can gzip and sample traces to mitigate (B).
Sara: UX: per-tenant opt-in + console toggle to compare legacy vs normalized buckets, and per-model distribution preview.
Emma: prefer per-model/tenant toggles. routing sensitivity should be model-scoped.
Raj: model-scoped routing needs model_id + distribution signature in routing path, increases cache keys.
Kevin: acceptable if it stabilizes SLAs. ops wants global fallback mapping when signature missing.
Miguel: plan: collector emits both fields during transition: score_float and score_q16 = int16(round(score*32767)). telemetry pipelines pass both; console shows toggle; default flip to float after 2 weeks.
Emma: suggested proto for canary:
```
message RerankScoreEvent {
  string model_id = 1;
  float score_float = 2;
  int32 score_q16 = 3;
  map<string,string> meta = 4;
}
```
Raj: router will prefer score_float when present, decode q16 otherwise. I'll add unit tests.
Sara: console: add "Use legacy score encoding" toggle with tooltip + timestamp when model started emitting float. include distribution preview in rollout modal.
Kevin: gating: 5% tenants canary. SLO: <=2% change in 95th throttle rate. I'll add side-by-side dashboard.
Emma: @deploy-bot status?
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: rerank-collector/v2 on rerank-canary (3 pods). mem <70%, p50 latency +3ms.
Miguel: pushing collector PR behind feature flag (dual fields) for canary tenants.
Raj: router PR to prefer float, fallback decode. adding integration tests.
Sara: product wiring toggle + copy.
Kevin: will add SLO checks and canary gating.
Emma: action items assigned. reconvene after canary metrics. :thumbsup:
